name: Timothy Antoni
bio: Timothy is a PhD student at NUS School of Computing. He completed his bachelor's in Biomedical Engineering in NUS. His main research interest is in leveraging AI systems to understand and support the regulation of addictive behaviors including smoking, vaping, gaming, and alcohol. When not tinkering, he is usually found playing guitar, chess, table tennis, or spending quality time.

publications.title: Interrupting Autopilot: Evaluating Sensory Interventions for Momentary Self-Regulation
